## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 12, at **$96 per month**. It is the only vendor whose minimum (5 seats) falls below the team size, so all 12 seats are billed at the list rate with no padding. Acme Desk bills for 25 seats and Fennel HQ for 50, inflating both far beyond their headline rates at this headcount.

## Vendors

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $14 | 25 |
| Fennel HQ | $19 | 50 |
| Kelp | $8 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 12 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 5 is below 12, so 12 seats paid. 12 × $8 = **$96 per month**. Effective rate $8.00 per person.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 25 exceeds 12, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**. 13 unused seats, worth $182. Effective rate $29.17 per person ($350 ÷ 12).
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 50 exceeds 12, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**. 38 unused seats, worth $722. Effective rate $79.17 per person ($950 ÷ 12).

Kelp is $254 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $854 cheaper than Fennel HQ — $3,048 and $10,248 per year.

## Risks

Seat minimums, not per-seat rates, drive this result, so the gap narrows with growth. Acme Desk's $350 is fixed until 25 seats, where Kelp costs $200; Kelp remains cheaper on list price at every size, since its $8 rate is the lowest on the list.

This is a price comparison only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, or security, so a cheaper seat may buy less product.

All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding and migration costs are not on the price list and could change the ranking. Confirm whether minimums are enforced at signup or only at renewal.
